habits.boundary_condition: Do not generalize this to unrelated amenities such as microwave, balcony, bar, fireplace, room size, location, dates, or price; those were not consistently supported across all sources.
habits.condition: When choosing hotels for leisure-oriented stays such as family, vacation, or activity trips.
habits.default_action: Include an in-room coffee maker and refrigerator/mini-fridge as soft default amenity criteria when searching or comparing hotels.
habits.exception_condition: If a hotel otherwise strongly matches the trip, treat a missing coffee maker or mini-fridge as a point to confirm with the user rather than an automatic rejection.
habits.name: leisure hotel room coffee-and-fridge default
habits.preference_value: Prefer a hotel room with both a coffee maker and a refrigerator or mini-fridge.
habits.rationale: Three independent hotel dialogues each include an explicit request for both a coffee maker and a refrigerator/mini-fridge in leisure-style lodging contexts. The repeated pairing supports a reusable soft default, but not a hard universal requirement.

source_evidence.contribution: Supports the paired preference for an in-room coffee maker and refrigerator during a family hotel search.
Independently repeats the same paired room-amenity preference during a summer vacation hotel search.
source_evidence.exact_user_quote: A mini refrigerator and coffee maker.

source_evidence.contribution: Independently repeats the same paired room-amenity preference for a leisure/activity-oriented hotel stay.
